subject: Re: ACME competitive bake-off: test plan & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME competitive bake-off: discovery recap + proposed test plan

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the detailed run-through of ACME's inference goals. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can align on success criteria before the bake-off: 

What we heard from the call:
- Primary goal: reduce per-query latency for customer-facing chat from ~350ms to <200ms while maintaining answer quality.
- Workload: mixed short (avg 60 tokens) and long (avg 600 tokens) contexts; peak 400 RPS expected during spikes.
- Key comparators: current internal endpoint (on-prem) + hyperscaler managed endpoints (GCP/Vertex + AWS Bedrock).
- Security: VPC-only deployment preferred, SOC2 evidence requested during procurement.

Proposed next steps / test plan (attached spreadsheet):
1) Bake-off scope: latency, p99, throughput, token cost, and answer quality (BLEU/ROUGE + a 50-question prompt set you provided).
2) Test variants: Redwood optimized (quantized), Redwood default, Hyperscaler baseline (Vertex), ACME on-prem baseline.
3) Success criteria: p95 < 220ms for short-context queries; no more than 10% quality regression vs ACME baseline on the prompt set.
4) Timeline: test config and owners defined by EOD Friday; setup + smoke runs next week; full run in 2 weeks.

I attached the initial bake-off criteria and a short one-pager comparing Redwood vs hyperscalers. Vanessa will help coordinate infra. Aditya, can your team take point on test harness and configs?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 30m to align.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments:
- acme-bakeoff-criteria.xlsx (xlsx)
- redwood-vs-hyperscalers-onepager.pdf (pdf)

We prefer the timeline — EOD Friday for owners is fine. Also, our security team will send a SOC2 questionnaire (Priya copied) — can we loop in your security contact if needed?

Jordan
